issues.where: Red water directly below the dome in the upper comparison
issues.what: Separate ripple reflections merge into short rectangular streaks; the softer water below them breaks into patches instead of fading smoothly.
issues.fix: Give the moving water more bits and lower quantization until the individual ripple highlights and their soft falloff survive.

issues.where: Lower comparison, across the curved left shoulder and crown of the transparent dome
